name: metric-ticker
description: 三数字横排：关键指标一屏看全（数字密度强调）
css: #tpl-metric-ticker { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .mt-hair { width: 64px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .85; margin-bottom: 4vh; transform-origin: left center; } .mt-row { display: flex; gap: 6vw; } .mt { flex: 1; } .mt b { display: block; font-size: 8vh; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .mt i { font-style: normal; font-size: 1.9vh; opacity: .6; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .mt-hair", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .mt", { opacity: 0, y: 44 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.16 }, {start} + 0.3);
